component.name: Quran Everywhere
component.summary: A clean, focused, bilingual Quran reader

description.p: Quran Everywhere is a clean, distraction-free Quran reader. Browse all 114 surahs, jump to any surah instantly, and pick up where you left off with automatic last-read position tracking. Read the Arabic Uthmani text alone, or ayah-by-ayah with the Sahih International English translation underneath each verse.

ul.li: Complete Quran text — all 6236 ayahs in Uthmani script
Audio recitation (Mishary Rashid Alafasy) with ayah highlighting and automatic continuation into the next surah; download to listen offline
Bilingual interface — Arabic and English, with a language switcher
Last-read position saved automatically across sessions
Offline reading — the Quran text needs no connection; audio streams online or can be downloaded for offline listening

screenshot.caption: Read ayah-by-ayah with the English translation
Audio recitation with ayah highlighting and a playback bar
Jump to any surah with the search drawer
Bilingual interface, with settings in Arabic or English
